messages.subject: Project Mosaic - DD and documentation timetable
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Now that exclusivity is running, a proposed timetable so we hold the 30 September completion target:

- Legal, financial and IP DD off the data room through the first half of August.
- We circulate the first draft Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement (the SPA) and Investor Rights Agreement w/c 12 August.
- Your mark-up back by end August; negotiation and settle through early September.
- Sign and complete week of 9 September, longstop 31 October.

Our DD request list is attached to the data room index. Shout if the dates are unworkable your end.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
